sloka: मुमोच सलिल उत्पीडान् विप्रकीर्ण शिलोउच्चयः ।वित्रस्त मृग मातंगः प्रकंपित महा द्रुमः ॥४-६७-४४॥
transliteration: mumoca salila utpīḍān viprakīrṇa śilouccayaḥ ।vitrasta mṛga mātaṁgaḥ prakaṁpita mahā drumaḥ ॥4-67-44॥

translations.english: Crushed by the feet of the great self, Hanuman, the huge mountain looked like a proud elephant struck by a lion.
